aggregation.missingness: No imputation; every terminal attempt remains in denominators.
aggregation.uncertainty: 95% deterministic percentile bootstrap interval of the mean

bench_notes.publication_policy: Record controlled observations and dispositions as work occurs; exclude raw native output, exception text, host paths, credentials, and provider identifiers.

comparison.exact: Complete ordered per-run vectors and control dispositions match.
comparison.failed: A complete interval lies outside its bound.
comparison.unavailable: A declared metric is absent from either lane; no tolerance is inferred.

analysis_plan.description: Lane summaries and predeclared bounded differences.

missing_data_policy.handling: Retain all terminal attempts in denominators; do not impute or silently drop.
missing_data_policy.missingness_assumption: Missingness is apparatus- or failure-induced, not random.
missing_data_policy.sensitivity_analysis: Unavailable declared metrics weaken the applicable tier.

multiple_comparison_policy.rationale: No hypothesis-test or general population claim is made.

assumptions: Attempts are the fixed scheduled episodes and are not replaced after failure.
statistical_method.estimand: RAES-mediated lane mean minus source-native lane mean
statistical_method.method: descriptive lane summaries and difference in means

uncertainty_method.procedure: 10,000 counter-addressed SHA-256 resamples bound to the declaration digest.

behavioral_claims.evidence_boundary: Exactly ten preallocated terminal attempts per lane under the frozen issue-30 comparison and missingness rules.
explicit_non_claims: No trace, state, observation, deterministic-replay, or outcome-equivalence claim is made.
limitations: The lanes have different stochastic bindings and evaluator paths.
behavioral_claims.subject: The fixed CyberBattleSim credential-cache baseline selection

study.description: Frozen two-lane reproduction of the selected public credential-cache baseline.
inclusion_criteria: Only preallocated terminal attempts from the exact qualified selection are included.

primary-task.inclusion_rationale: The qualified public task owns all measured constructs.

study.purpose: Retain bounded readiness and reproduction evidence for OpenRAE/research#14 and OpenRAE/research#20 without asserting deterministic replay or outcome equivalence.
research_questions: Which authored, contract, control, observation, outcome, and disclosure facts survive the selected RAES-mediated execution?

run_allocation.replication_policy: Ten fixed scheduled episodes per lane; retry budget zero.
run_allocation.stopping_rule: Terminalize every scheduled attempt; do not replace failures.

study.title: CyberBattleSim chain source-native and RAES-mediated reproduction

validity_notes.mitigation: Record actual lane-specific binding dispositions and make no replay claim.
validity_notes.note: The source evaluator leaves four random streams unbound.
